hostPorts.purpose: Durable notification outbox owned by Notifications and dispatched through channel adapters.
Provider-specific SMS/RCS webhook verifier and normalizer for mobile messaging interactions.

notification-center.purpose: Own notification-center feed behavior, read state, APIs, and marketplace shell UI contracts.
notification-center.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.
expectedConsumers: Marketplace shell notification side sheet and bottom sheet

preferences.purpose: Own account notification preferences and settings behavior.
preferences.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide schema and service composition for the Notifications context.
runtime-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only for context runtime composition.
runtime-support.justification: runtime-support centralizes Notifications database adapters and service composition.
runtime-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when Notifications no longer needs runtime composition.

shell-support.purpose: Provide Notifications marketplace shell composition for deployable layout routes.
shell-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only for marketplace-web shell composition.
shell-support.justification: shell-support keeps Notification Center sheet composition outside feature route modules.
shell-support.createdFor: Notifications marketplace Notification Center side sheet and mobile bottom sheet.
shell-support.sunsetWhen: Remove if Notifications no longer contributes marketplace-web shell behavior.

routes.purpose: Reserve notifications-owned route metadata for future deployable route contributions.
routes.allowedWhen: Required by bounded-context structure metadata even when the context does not yet contribute page routes.
